# neurons.me

> Sovereign Semantic Runtime — .me, NRP, and the All.This ecosystem. A federated, local-first, O(K) reactive knowledge graph engine, developed under github.com/neurons-me.

For the full technical context (kernel axioms, `me://` URI forms, architecture layers, key invariants for LLMs working with this codebase), see [llm.md](https://neurons-me.github.io/llm.md).

## Core

- [.me](https://neurons-me.github.io/.me/): the kernel — O(K) reactive knowledge graph engine, operator algebra, 11 axioms.
- [.me Typescript typedocs](https://neurons-me.github.io/.me/Typescript/typedocs/): generated API reference for the kernel implementation.
- [Glossary](https://neurons-me.github.io/Glossary.html): terminology used across the ecosystem.
- [me:// URI Schema](https://neurons-me.github.io/me.URI.schema.html): the published `me://` URI scheme, Draft v0.1, CC0 1.0.
- [Secretos-me](https://neurons-me.github.io/Secretos-me.html): secret-scope mechanism — path-bound, structural, not a global toggle.

## Namespace Resolution Protocol (NRP)

- [NRP — index](https://neurons-me.github.io/NRP/): how a `me://` URI resolves from a symbolic address to a concrete value across a distributed mesh, without a central registry.
- [NRP status](https://neurons-me.github.io/NRP/status.html): current implementation status.
- [NRP v0.2.1](https://neurons-me.github.io/NRP/v.0.2.1.html): protocol version spec.
- [NRP v0.1.2](https://neurons-me.github.io/NRP/v.0.1.2.html): earlier protocol version spec.
- [Surface Access Points and Routing](https://neurons-me.github.io/NRP/Surface-Access-Points-and-Routing.html): how surfaces expose and route within NRP.

## Ecosystem Modules

- [GUI](https://neurons-me.github.io/GUI/): interface generation layer.
- [Cleaker](https://neurons-me.github.io/Cleaker/): namespace binding — identity mounting, context lens, ledger replay (`cleaker(me, {secret}) → me.learn()`).
- [monad](https://neurons-me.github.io/monad/): federated runtime — durable ledger, surfaces, snapshots (`monad.ai`).
- [netget](https://neurons-me.github.io/netget/): registry and proxy mesh, trust materialization.
- [all.this](https://neurons-me.github.io/all.this/): DSL / projections monorepo.
- [neurons-me](https://neurons-me.github.io/neurons-me/): organization root.

## Source

- [github.com/neurons-me/.me](https://github.com/neurons-me/.me): kernel source.
- [github.com/neurons-me/monad](https://github.com/neurons-me/monad): federated runtime source.
- [github.com/neurons-me/netget](https://github.com/neurons-me/netget): registry/proxy source.
- [github.com/neurons-me/cleaker](https://github.com/neurons-me/cleaker): namespace binding source.
- [github.com/neurons-me/all.this](https://github.com/neurons-me/all.this): DSL/projections source.
- [github.com/neurons-me/GUI](https://github.com/neurons-me/GUI): interface generation source.
